import math

# Data from the Treasury Bulletins
# Calendar year 1980 (12 months): Jan-Dec 1980
# From 1980 bulletin: Jan-Oct 1980
# From 1981 bulletin: Nov-Dec 1980 (the bulletin explicitly shows these)

# 1980 data - first 10 months from 1980 bulletin (Jan-Oct 1980)
data_1980 = [350, 347, 341, 332, 322, 308, 307, 306, 304, 303]

# 1980 data - last 2 months from 1981 bulletin (Nov-Dec 1980)
# These are the values shown in the 1981 bulletin for 1980
data_1980.extend([102, 100])  # Nov, Dec 1980

# 1981 data - Jan-Oct 1981 from 1981 bulletin
data_1981 = [100, 295, 287, 283, 282, 279, 276, 275, 273, 270]

# Combine all 22 months
all_data = data_1980 + data_1981

print("All 22 monthly values (millions of dollars):")
print("1980:", data_1980)
print("1981:", data_1981)
print("Combined:", all_data)
print("Number of observations:", len(all_data))

# Calculate mean (population mean)
n = len(all_data)
mean = sum(all_data) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate population standard deviation (N in denominator)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in all_data) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population standard deviation: {pop_std}")

# Calculate 95% VaR using the parametric method
# VaR = mean - 1.645 * population_std
z_score = 1.645
var = mean - z_score * pop_std

print(f"\n95% VaR calculation:")
print(f"VaR = {mean} - 1.645 * {pop_std}")
print(f"VaR = {mean} - {z_score * pop_std}")
print(f"VaR = {var}")

# The absolute magnitude as a positive value rounded to nearest whole number
var_magnitude = abs(var)
result = round(var_magnitude)
print(f"\nAbsolute VaR magnitude: {var_magnitude}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest whole number: {result}")
EOF
